SELECT id, receiver_name, phone, full_address, create_time, update_time, is_deleted FROM express_address WHERE is_deleted = 0
AND ( receiver_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR full_address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' )
ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC
